description: Hourly Polish Electricity Day-Ahead Market Dataset: Prices, Grid Load, Renewable Generation, and Weather (July 2024 – September 2025), published by Kharchenko, Yurii; Batsiun, Yevhen, combines Polish electricity-market price, volume, demand, renewable generation and weather for a forecasting study. Coverage: Polish market observations from July 2024 to September 2025, one row per hour. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: This is the exact training and evaluation dataset for one forecasting paper; reuse or subsequent maintenance has not been demonstrated. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
